questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions. This sign tells drivers that the road will soon be divided.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There are trucks hauling gravel ahead.
The highway ahead is under construction.
The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
The highway ahead has been sanded for icy conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is covered with loose gravel.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that loose gravel is ahead. Slow down and be careful on gravel roads because your tires will have less grip than on pavement.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs point in the direction the road curves. Multiple signs may be placed throughout the curve to guide you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign shows that multiple lanes are available for left turns. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts drivers that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to wait for the left turn signal before turning. Only turn when the signal indicates it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. Follow their directions carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that pedestrians cross the road ahead. Drive with caution and be ready to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging, move to another lane if it is safe to do so. This helps vehicles enter the roadway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must give pedestrians the right of way at crosswalks. Watch for pedestrians when driving through intersections or turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous for both drivers and workers. Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful in these areas. This sign tells drivers that penalties for unsafe driving are higher in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road hazards. This sign warns you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed limit for highway exits. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that wet pavement may be slippery and make your vehicle harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic movement and tell drivers what they must do. This sign means you can either turn left or go straight from this lane at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is not allowed. You cannot make U-turns where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane will end ahead. You must move your vehicle to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the bridge ahead may not be wide enough to pass or meet a truck safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A divided highway is coming up. The road will split into two one-way lanes separated by a divider. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should drive with the flow of traffic.
Limit your speed for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum speed you are allowed to drive on this road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you about road work ahead. Be careful and watch for construction workers and equipment. Slow down and follow any special instructions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to possible hazards ahead. This sign warns you that buggies may be on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to possible hazards ahead. This sign warns you that deer may cross the road in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: On vertical traffic lights, red is always on top and green is always on the bottom. On horizontal lights, red is always on the left and green is always on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a road crossing ahead will create an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to possible hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic is coming from both directions on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a bus stop ahead.
There is a stop sign ahead.
There is a caution sign ahead.
You must stop if other cars stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a stop sign ahead.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming up so you can prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash through it means the action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.
